paper_reference.published_path_energy_convention: Eq. (B.2) explicitly evaluates Gamma_abs_star(r'(s), omega) with one fixed omega along the chord. Gravitational source redshift enters Eq. (B.1) through N(r)^2 and omega_min=m_V/N(r).

profile_provenance_warning: The radial profile is reconstructed from public figure paths. It is not the original s18.8-SFHo-MUONS simulation table used by Blinov et al.

eq_b2_fixed_omega_baseline.prescription: Gamma_abs_star(r'(s), omega_source)/v_V(omega_source), with the same omega argument along the complete chord.

outer_mu_numu_branch_opacity_sensitivity.scope: Opacity-only sensitivity: mu_numu is set to zero for r>=15 km; the source term remains the baseline B.1 source. This isolates the visible positive mu_numu branch at about 16.6--18.4 km.

path_absorption_radial_decomposition.weighting: Eq. (B.1) optically thin source weight over emission radius and energy, averaged uniformly over the full Eq. (B.2) direction range

kinematic_range.path_measure: same Euclidean chord ds as Eq. (B.2); no metric path-length correction

path_redshift_only_diagnostic.prescription: omega_local(s)=omega_source*N(source)/N(path); update local rates and v_V(s), while retaining the same Euclidean ds and straight chord. This is a sensitivity diagnostic, not the published Eq. (B.2) baseline or a full GR ray trace.

profile.identity: reconstructed public-figure SFHo-18.8, t_pb=1 s profile; not original Garching raw table

results.reference_axis_conversion: The digitized Fig. 7 abscissa is alpha_V; the source extraction converts it to g=sqrt(4*pi*alpha_V). Rates and opacity are normalized per g^2 and the scan uses this g.

scope: The baseline is the literal fixed-omega Eq. (B.2) prescription.
The path-redshift alternative changes only the local energy argument and local vector speed; it retains the Euclidean chord measure and is not a full GR ray-tracing calculation.
No coupling, production, absorption, opacity, profile, or luminosity rescaling.
No axial curve, PR #56 file, manuscript, or referee-response file is modified.
